justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/TypeParameterMetaModel.java`, `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/type/TypeParameter.java`, and `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/JavaParserMetaModel.java` (plus `ReferenceTypeMetaModel.java`/`TypeMetaModel.java` for context). `TypeParameterMetaModel` is a generated leaf wrapper extending `ReferenceTypeMetaModel`; its own body only depends on `TypeParameter`, `Optional`, and the superclass, and it declares just two property fields. Repo-wide search found only one AST client (`TypeParameter.getMetaModel()` returns `JavaParserMetaModel.typeParameterMetaModel`) and the central registry wiring in `JavaParserMetaModel` (singleton creation plus property/constructor setup). No other classes reference it, so incoming and outgoing dependencies are too limited for hub-like modularization.
